import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotientOpen
import Mathlib.Topology.Constructions

/-!
# Restriction of geometric quotients

The geometric quotient conditions are preserved on every target open. This
allows the quotient of a stable source open to be compared with its affine
invariant-ring presentation.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry TopologicalSpace

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction

variable {G : Type u} [Group G] {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
  (act : G →* Aut X)

/-- The action induced on a stable open subscheme. -/
noncomputable def restrictAction {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsStableOpen act U) :
    G →* Aut U.toScheme where
  toFun g :=
    { hom := actRes act hU g
      inv := actRes act hU g⁻¹
      hom_inv_id := actRes_actRes_inv act hU g
      inv_hom_id := actRes_inv_actRes act hU g }
  map_one' := by
    apply Iso.ext
    exact actRes_one act hU
  map_mul' g t := by
    apply Iso.ext
    exact actRes_mul act hU g t

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem restrictAction_hom_ι {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsStableOpen act U) (g : G) :
    (restrictAction act hU g).hom ≫ U.ι = U.ι ≫ (act g).hom :=
  actRes_ι act hU g

namespace IsGeometricQuotient

variable {act} {q : X ⟶ Y} (hq : IsGeometricQuotient act q)

include hq in
/-- Pullback to an equal presentation of a preimage open is injective. -/
theorem appLE_injective (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (hV : V = q ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    Function.Injective (q.appLE U V hV.le) := by
  subst V
  simpa only [Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app] using hq.app_injective U

include hq in
/-- The invariant-section criterion permits an equal presentation of the
preimage open. -/
theorem mem_range_appLE (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (hV : V = q ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (hs : IsStableOpen act V) (s : Γ(X, V)) :
    s ∈ Set.range (q.appLE U V hV.le) ↔
      ∀ g : G, (actApp act hs g).hom s = s := by
  subst V
  simpa only [Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app] using hq.mem_range_app U s

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Restricting a geometric quotient to any open in its target is again a
geometric quotient for the restricted source action. -/
theorem restrict (U : Y.Opens) :
    IsGeometricQuotient
      (restrictAction act (isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant act q hq.invariant U))
      (q ∣_ U) := by
  let hs := isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant act q hq.invariant U
  have hinv (g : G) :
      (restrictAction act hs g).hom ≫ q ∣_ U = q ∣_ U := by
    apply (cancel_mono U.ι).mp
    simp only [Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι, restrictAction_hom_ι_assoc,
      hq.invariant]
  refine
    { invariant := hinv
      isQuotientMap := ?_
      eq_iff := ?_
      app_injective := ?_
      mem_range_app := ?_ }
  · rw [morphismRestrict_base]
    exact hq.isQuotientMap.restrictPreimage_isOpen U.isOpen
  · intro x y
    constructor
    · intro hxy
      have hxy' : q x.1 = q y.1 := by
        simpa only [morphismRestrict_base_coe] using congrArg Subtype.val hxy
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (hq.eq_iff x.1 y.1).mp hxy'
      refine ⟨g, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
      exact (Scheme.Hom.coe_resLE_apply _ _ x).trans hg
    · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
      exact (congrArg (fun f => f x) (hinv g)).symm
  · intro V
    rw [morphismRestrict_app']
    exact hq.appLE_injective _ _ (image_morphismRestrict_preimage q U V)
  · intro V s
    rw [morphismRestrict_app']
    let D := (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((q ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    have hD : D = q ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ''ᵁ V) := image_morphismRestrict_preimage q U V
    have hsD : IsStableOpen act D := hD.symm ▸
      isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant act q hq.invariant (U.ι ''ᵁ V)
    have h := hq.mem_range_appLE (U.ι ''ᵁ V) D hD hsD s
    refine h.trans ?_
    apply forall_congr'
    intro g
    change ((act g).hom.appLE D D _).hom s = s ↔
      ((actRes act hs g).appLE ((q ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V) ((q ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V) _).hom s = s
    simp only [actRes, Scheme.Hom.resLE_appLE]
    rfl

end IsGeometricQuotient
end MilneLib.StableGroupAction
